# NCLEX Study Todo List

## 📋 **Initial Assessment & Planning**
- [ ] Register for NCLEX exam
- [ ] Determine your test date timeline (6-8 weeks minimum prep recommended)
- [ ] Take a diagnostic practice test to identify weak areas
- [ ] Create a realistic study schedule (aim for 2-4 hours daily)
- [ ] Gather study materials and resources

## 📚 **Content Review**
- [ ] **Fundamentals of Nursing**
  - Nursing process and critical thinking
  - Safety and infection control
  - Health promotion and maintenance
- [ ] **Pharmacology**
  - Drug classifications and actions
  - Medication administration and safety
  - Side effects and interactions
- [ ] **Medical-Surgical Nursing**
  - Body systems and pathophysiology
  - Common diseases and treatments
- [ ] **Maternal-Newborn Nursing**
- [ ] **Pediatric Nursing**
- [ ] **Mental Health Nursing**
- [ ] **Leadership and Management**

## 🎯 **Practice Questions Strategy**
- [ ] Complete 50-100 practice questions daily
- [ ] Focus on SATA (Select All That Apply) questions
- [ ] Practice prioritization and delegation questions
- [ ] Review rationales for both correct and incorrect answers
- [ ] Take timed practice exams weekly
- [ ] Aim for 65-70% consistency on practice tests

## 🧠 **Test-Taking Strategies**
- [ ] Learn to identify what the question is really asking
- [ ] Practice ABC (Airway, Breathing, Circulation) prioritization
- [ ] Master Maslow's hierarchy for prioritizing care
- [ ] Use nursing process (ADPIE) to guide answers
- [ ] Practice eliminating obviously wrong answers

## 📖 **Recommended Study Resources**
- [ ] **NCLEX Review Books**: Saunders, Kaplan, or ATI
- [ ] **Question Banks**: UWorld, NCLEX Mastery, or Kaplan
- [ ] **Apps**: NCLEX RN Mastery, Saunders NCLEX
- [ ] **Videos**: RegisteredNurseRN, Khan Academy
- [ ] **Practice Tests**: NCSBN Learning Extension

## ⏰ **Final Week Preparation**
- [ ] Take a comprehensive practice exam
- [ ] Review weak areas identified in practice tests
- [ ] Do light review (avoid cramming new material)
- [ ] Prepare test day logistics (location, documents, timing)
- [ ] Get adequate sleep (7-8 hours before exam)

## 🏥 **Day of Exam**
- [ ] Arrive 30 minutes early
- [ ] Bring required identification
- [ ] Stay calm and use test-taking strategies
- [ ] Take breaks if needed
- [ ] Trust your preparation

## 📊 **Weekly Goals**
- [ ] **Week 1-2**: Complete content review and baseline assessment
- [ ] **Week 3-4**: Heavy practice questions (75-100 daily)
- [ ] **Week 5-6**: Focus on weak areas and full-length practice exams
- [ ] **Week 7-8**: Final review and exam preparation

## 💡 **Study Tips**
- [ ] Join NCLEX study groups or forums
- [ ] Teach concepts to others to reinforce learning
- [ ] Use memory aids and mnemonics
- [ ] Stay consistent with daily study routine
- [ ] Take care of physical and mental health during prep

**Target Score**: Consistently scoring 65-70% on practice questions indicates readiness for the actual NCLEX.

Good luck with your NCLEX preparation! 🍀
